product_story.summary: The candidate rejected stale rapid-review evidence and preserved human risk authority.
limitations: This example does not establish production safety.

testing_story.summary: The investigation exercised candidate mismatch, mandatory charter presence, and residual-risk reporting.
limitations: Hosted CI and model-provider behavior were not exercised.

quality_of_testing_story.summary: Direct schema and policy oracles were strong; same-model semantic coverage remains fallible.
limitations: No finite charter can prove absence of unknown defects.

residual_risks: Same-model correlated blind spots require human consideration.
